zh.title: 華信航空首推台東至澎湖直航包機 9月11日正式啟航
zh.summary: 華信航空推出台東至澎湖直航包機，於9月11日啟航並規劃5班次往返。
body: 華信航空首度攜手華府旅行社推出台東至澎湖直航包機，首航班機於2026年9月11日正式啟航。從台東直飛澎湖單程飛行時間為75分鐘。
首航班機AE7951於9月11日上午9時50分自台東機場起飛，11時05分抵達澎湖機場；回程AE7952班機於中午12時10分自澎湖起飛，下午1時20分抵達台東機場。
華信航空總經理莊明哲指出，台東至澎湖包機於9月11日、13日、15日、17日及19日共推出5班次往返。董事長陳大鈞表示，公司依市場需求彈性調度運能。

en.title: Mandarin Airlines Launches Direct Taitung-Penghu Charter Flights
en.summary: Mandarin Airlines launched direct charter flights between Taitung and Penghu on September 11 with five round trips.
body: Mandarin Airlines, in partnership with Grand Tour Travel Agency, has launched non-stop charter flights between Taitung and Penghu, with inaugural services commencing on September 11, 2026. The direct flight shortens travel time between the two destinations to 75 minutes.

The inaugural outbound flight AE7951 departed Taitung Airport at 9:50 a.m. on September 11 and arrived at Penghu Airport at 11:05 a.m. The return flight AE7952 departed Penghu at 12:10 p.m. and arrived in Taitung at 1:20 p.m.

Mandarin Airlines General Manager Chuang Ming-che stated that a total of five round-trip charter flights are scheduled on September 11, 13, 15, 17, and 19. Chairman Chen Ta-chun added that aircraft capacity is allocated flexibly based on market demand.

zh.title: TARMAC與AerFin合作拆解逾十架A320neo與波音737 MAX
zh.summary: TARMAC與AerFin合作拆解逾十架A320neo與737 MAX
body: 飛機拆解與循環利用業者 TARMAC Aerosave 於 2026 年 9 月 11 日宣佈，已與合作夥伴 AerFin 達成協議，預計在今年底前拆解超過 10 架空中巴士 A320neo 及波音 737 MAX 系列客機。
為因應市場對新世代飛機發動機與零組件的強烈需求，TARMAC Aerosave 針對 AerFin 的特定需求設立了專用作業線，負責客艙與起落架拆卸等作業，並建立專責團隊管理零件清單。
成立於 2007 年的 TARMAC Aerosave 由空中巴士、Safran 與 SUEZ 共同持股。該公司與 AerFin 的合作夥伴關係已歷經 10 年，雙方目前正著手規劃 2027 年的新合作項目。

en.title: TARMAC Aerosave to tear down over 10 A320neo and 737 MAX jets for AerFin
en.summary: TARMAC Aerosave and AerFin partner to tear down over 10 A320neo and 737 MAX aircraft by year-end.
body: Aircraft dismantling specialist TARMAC Aerosave announced on September 11, 2026, that over 10 Airbus A320neo and Boeing 737 MAX family aircraft have been earmarked for teardown before the end of the year under an agreement with AerFin.

Driven by strong market demand for next-generation engines and spare parts, TARMAC Aerosave has established a dedicated organization and assembly line tailored to AerFin's specific operational needs. The dedicated line will handle cabin and landing gear removal as well as component list management.

Founded in 2007, TARMAC Aerosave is jointly owned by Airbus, Safran, and SUEZ. The partnership between TARMAC Aerosave and AerFin spans 10 years, with both entities already preparing additional teardown projects for 2027.

zh.title: 深圳航空12月開航深圳雪梨航線 每週四班A330執飛
zh.summary: 深圳航空12月14日起開航深圳至雪梨；每週營運四班並以A330客機執飛
body: 深圳航空（Shenzhen Airlines）計劃於2026年12月14日起，開航往返深圳寶安國際機場（SZX）與雪梨機場（SYD）的直飛客運航線。該航線每週營運四班，將進一步加強澳洲與中國之間的空中交通連結，並使深圳航空成為雪梨機場第十家進駐營運的中國航空公司。
根據航班營運規劃，去程航班號為ZH815，預計於當地時間凌晨00:20自深圳寶安國際機場起飛，並於當地時間下午13:40抵達雪梨機場；回程航班號則為ZH816，預計於當地時間晚上22:30自雪梨機場起飛，並於次日凌晨05:25返抵深圳。該航線將使用空中巴士A330-300廣體客機執飛，預計每年可增加約13萬個座位，並服務約10萬名旅客。
雪梨機場方面表示，深圳航空的加入將使其營運的航空公司總數達到創紀錄的55家。雪梨機場執行長Scott Charlton指出，中國仍是雪梨機場最重要的國際市場之一，根據2026年第二季的客運數據，中國籍旅客已成為該機場第二大國際旅客群體，年增率達13.9%。
深圳為雪梨機場成長最快的中國大陸目的地之一，在2025年名列該機場第七大中國大陸直飛目的地，雙向旅客人數年增16%，達到5.6萬人次。深圳航空董事長李樹興表示，開通首條雪梨航線是拓展國際網絡的重要舉措，預期將為兩地旅客提供更多選擇與便利，並促進中國與澳洲之間的旅遊、貿易與文化交流。

en.title: Shenzhen Airlines to Launch Four-Weekly Shenzhen-Sydney Service in December
en.summary: Shenzhen Airlines will launch a four-weekly Shenzhen-Sydney service using Airbus A330-300 aircraft starting December 14.
body: Shenzhen Airlines is set to launch a new four-times-weekly service connecting Shenzhen Bao'an International Airport (SZX) in China and Sydney Airport (SYD) in Australia starting December 14, 2026. The route will further strengthen air links between Australia and China, marking Shenzhen Airlines' entry as Sydney Airport's newest carrier.

The upcoming service will be operated using an Airbus A330-300 aircraft, adding approximately 130,000 seats annually and supporting an estimated 100,000 passengers each year. Flight ZH815 is scheduled to depart Shenzhen at 00:20 local time and arrive at Sydney Airport at 13:40 local time. The return flight, ZH816, is scheduled to depart Sydney at 22:30 local time and arrive in Shenzhen at 05:25 local time the following day.

The addition of Shenzhen Airlines will increase the total number of airlines operating at Sydney Airport to a record 55, while making Shenzhen Airlines the airport's tenth Chinese-based carrier. Sydney Airport Chief Executive Officer Scott Charlton stated that China remains one of the airport's most important international markets, with Chinese nationals forming the second-largest international traveler group after a 13.9% year-on-year increase in second-quarter 2026 traffic data.

Shenzhen ranked as Sydney Airport's seventh-largest mainland China destination in 2025, with direct annual passenger traffic growing 16% year-on-year to reach 56,000 passengers. Shenzhen Airlines Chairman Li Shuxing declared that the airline is pleased to launch its first service to Sydney as an important addition to its international network, expected to provide greater choice and convenience for travelers while supporting tourism, trade, and cultural ties between China and Australia.

zh.title: 越旅航空訂購50架空中巴士客機 越航簽署5架A350備忘錄
zh.summary: 越旅航空訂購50架空中巴士客機；越南航空簽署5架A350 MOU
body: 越旅航空（Vietravel Airlines）於2026年9月10日在法國巴黎簽署協議，向空中巴士訂購50架客機，包含20架A220系列客機與30架空中巴士A321（ICAO機型代碼A321）系列客機。該航空公司預計訂單將涵蓋A321neo與A321XLR等衍生機型，首批新機預定於2029年開始交付。
同日，越南航空（Vietnam Airlines）亦與空中巴士簽署諒解備忘錄（MOU），擬規劃引進5架空中巴士A350-900廣體客機。越南航空表示，該批A350-900客機預計於2033年至2034年間交付，此合作案為該公司長程機隊發展戰略的一部分，旨在因應2030年後國際航空旅遊需求的成長。
本次簽約活動係於巴黎愛麗舍宮舉行的雙邊峰會期間進行。越南國家主席蘇林與法國總統馬克宏（Emmanuel Macron）會面討論深化兩國經濟與投資合作。T&T集團創辦人兼執行長杜光顯（Do Quang Hien）與空中巴士國際主席韋爾許（Wouter van Wersch）等高層代表均出席簽署儀式。
越旅航空說明，同時選擇A220與A321neo客機符合其航網發展的長期規劃。其中A220客機將用於開闢前往缺乏定期直飛航班區域的新航線，A321neo則將投入高需求量及長程國際航線。據ch-aviation資料，越旅航空目前營運4架A321-200與1架空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）客機。
越南航空目前在長程機隊中營運14架空中巴士A350-900廣體客機與16架波音787客機。空中巴士商業飛機銷售執行副總裁聖埃克蘇佩里（Benoît de Saint-Exupéry）表示，具備長程性能與營運效率的A350-900客機，將能有效支援越南航空未來數年擴展國際航網的計畫。

en.title: Vietravel Airlines Orders 50 Airbus Aircraft as Vietnam Airlines Signs MOU for Five A350s
en.summary: Vietravel Airlines orders 50 Airbus jets, while Vietnam Airlines signs an MOU for five A350-900 aircraft.
body: Vietravel Airlines signed an agreement to purchase 50 Airbus aircraft on September 10, 2026, during a bilateral summit in Paris. The commitment includes 20 A220s and 30 Airbus A321 (ICAO type code A321) aircraft. The carrier stated that it expects the A321 portion of the deal to comprise both A321neo and A321XLR variants, with initial deliveries scheduled to begin in 2029.

On the same day, national flag carrier Vietnam Airlines signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Airbus for the proposed acquisition of five A350-900 widebody aircraft. Deliveries for the A350-900 jets are expected between 2033 and 2034. According to the airline, the MoU supports its broader fleet development strategy to acquire 30 widebody aircraft beyond 2030 to meet growing international travel demand.

The signing ceremonies took place at the Élysée Palace in Paris during a summit meeting between Vietnamese President To Lam and French President Emmanuel Macron aimed at strengthening trade and economic cooperation. Senior representatives attending the ceremony included Do Quang Hien, founder and CEO of T&T Group, which owns Vietravel Airlines, and Wouter van Wersch, chairman of Airbus International.

Vietravel Airlines noted that selecting both the A220 and A321neo fits its long-term network vision. The carrier plans to deploy the A220 on new direct routes to underserved regional destinations, while using the larger A321neos for higher-demand and longer international routes. According to ch-aviation data, Vietravel currently operates four A321-200s and a single Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320).

Vietnam Airlines currently operates 14 A350-900 widebody aircraft and 16 Boeing 787 Dreamliners as part of its long-haul fleet. Benoît de Saint-Exupéry, Airbus Executive Vice President of Sales for Commercial Aircraft, expressed confidence that the long-haul capabilities and operational efficiency of the A350-900 will support Vietnam Airlines' plans to expand its international route network in the coming years.
